[LG Innotek] 2026 Global Internship (Hiring-Linked) for International Students
As a trusted technology partner and innovation leader transforming industries,
LG Innotek is leading future technological changes in electronics, mobility, and robotics, while realizing customers’ visions together.
We welcome talented individuals who want to change the world with us.
1. Open Positions ( Please refer to the detailed job posting)
2. Eligibility
Applicants who can work full-time in Korea for 5 weeks during July–August 2026
Foreign nationals enrolled in Korean universities as undergraduate students (3rd year or above), master’s/PhD students, or degree holders
(Graduates and those expected to graduate in August 2026 are also eligible)
Holders of TOPIK Level 4–6 (within the 2-year validity period)
Applicants who currently hold or can obtain a valid visa/status for internship participation
3. Preferred Qualifications
Strong language proficiency (business communication level preferred)
Recipients of GKS (Global Korea Scholarship) or those who completed KIIP Level 5
Target languages: English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Spanish, Polish, Indonesian
Preferred language requirements may differ by job category. Please refer to the detailed job posting.
4. Application
Deadline: ~ May 7, 2026 (Thu), 16:00 KST
Job Posting: https://careers.lg.com/apply/detail?id=1001631
Applications must be submitted online via LG Careers only
Final submission deadline is May 7 (Thu), 16:00 Korean Standard Time
Applications can be edited until the deadline after submission

2025 LG CNS Global Internship for International Students
(Internship with Opportunity for Full-Time Return Offer)
Hiring Position
DX Engineer (Front-end / Back-end Engineer)
: DX Engineers leverage their experiences working on projects in various industries and new IT technologies to provide customized services to clients,
while also enhancing the value of clients' businesses. This role will be responsible for a wide range of global IT projects, such as developing, operating,
and maintaining the quality of LG CNS's solutions and R&D application, while facilitating technical communication between teams in Korea and abroad, ensuring IT requests are understood and delivered effectively.
Qualifications
- International students, who have graduated or are expected to graduate by February 2025, with a bachelor's degree or above from a Korean university.
- Those with TOPIK level 4~6 or have equivalent Korean language proficiency.
- D-2 visa holders (or visa that permits part-time work) and those without any reasons to be denied from being issued an E-7 visa in the future.
Recruitment process
- Application > Coding test > 1st interview > Internship (Final interview conducted during internship period) + Personality assessment > Final job offer
- A coding test will be conducted for those that pass the application screening stage (Applicants may choose to conduct the coding test from the following: Python, JAVA, C, C# and C++).

This capacity building program provides a comprehensive understanding of the geological

Course Description
Major Practicum The course provides individualized weekly instruction that adapts to student performance and theoretical development levels, optimizing musical expression and theoretical understanding through personalized guidance.
History of Western
Music
The course examines significant composers and musical schools across historical periods, analyzing formal development and sociocultural
contexts through primary work examination.
20th Century Music The course analyzes modern musical developments from the late nineteenth century through the contemporary period, examining historical, sociocultural, and aesthetic perspectives, including serialism, modal systems, polytonality, and atonal composition.
Contemporary Music The course examines recent compositional works and various expressive modes, analyzing contemporary trends and techniques while developing innovative musical approaches.
Introduction to
Musicology
The course examines interdisciplinary musical connections through systematic historical analysis, focusing on twentieth-century musical
diversification and disciplinary categorization of different types of music.

Electronic Music

question: What's the maximum number of credits I can bring back from it, and who decides whether they count?
session_history: I'm an undergrad at ERICA and I'm planning a self-financed study abroad course during the summer seasonal semester.

passages.title: Self-financed Study Abroad Program
passages.text:
Regular semesters: A maximum of 20 credits may be transferred per semester, with a maximum of 40 credits per year
Seasonal semesters: A maximum of 6 credits may be transferred per application
Credits may be transferred as part of a student’s main major, second major, and minor , in liberal arts, or general elective credits (only for the pre-approved majors).
All authority for credit transfer lies with the college at which the student is enrolled in, and the process is also carried out by said college.
Only programs that can issue transcripts with credits for each subject can apply for credit transfer (Credits will NOT be transferred if the program issues certificates of completion only).

English track)

As a trusted technology partner and innovation leader transforming industries,
LG Innotek is leading future technological changes in electronics, mobility, and robotics, while realizing customers’ visions together.
We welcome talented individuals who want to change the world with us.

Applicants who can work full-time in Korea for 5 weeks during July–August 2026
Foreign nationals enrolled in Korean universities as undergraduate students (3rd year or above), master’s/PhD students, or degree holders
(Graduates and those expected to graduate in August 2026 are also eligible)
Holders of TOPIK Level 4–6 (within the 2-year validity period)
Applicants who currently hold or can obtain a valid visa/status for internship participation

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text:
Before departure, students must decide on the courses they plan to take at the hosting university and check with their home university's administrative team whether the courses can be transferred for credit.
As for minors and multiple majors, students must check in advance whether credits can be transferred by the relevant college at Hanyang University.

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text: Step 1 [Office of International Affairs]: School registration transfer and credit transfer procedures Returning students must complete their Return Report on the HY-in system (Student HY-in > Application > Credit Exchange Management > Exchange & Study Abroad > Exchange Study Abroad Application History menu)

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text: Step 2 [[Student]]: Upload the Return Report to HY-in Before the end of the Exchange/study abroad Program, students must read the Credit Transfer Procedure sent to their private e-mail account and enter all relevant coursework (information of the semester completed, courses taken (English), credits earned for each subject, grade) completed at the hosting university directly on the HY-in system (directory: Student HY-in - Application - Academic Grades - Hosting University Credit Transfer Application menu) (1) What if the hosting university does note grade students on an alphabetical grading system (e.g. ABCDF)? If the hosting university has a conversion table, use it to convert your academic grades. In the absence of such a table, use the “Academic Grade Conversion Table by Country (Europe)” sent via e-mail from the Office of International Affairs. (2) Do not alter ECTS information arbitrarily (e.g. Multiplying 2/3) Students must enter the ECTS on their transcript into the system as is, and the credits will be corrected and entered into the system once their college administrator reviews the credits. (3) What if a student receives an “F” grade or drops out of a course? Enter information as it appears on the academic transcript. ※ Caution Course names must be entered in English, and all credits or grades must be entered exactly as they appear on the transcript. If you discover an error that requires editing after submitting or printing documents, contact the administrative department at your college and

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text: Caution Course names must be entered in English, and all credits or grades must be entered exactly as they appear on the transcript. If you discover an error that requires editing after submitting or printing documents, contact the administrative department at your college and ask them to activate the Edit function in the Credit Transfer Application Menu. Once you click to save drafts, the system will register any input information or documents. Exercise caution when submitting all documents.

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text:
Step 3 [[Student]]: Submit materials for credit transfer review (1) Print out the Statement of Exchange Student Course Completion Upon entering academic grades in the HY-in system, click the <Print> button at the top of the screen to print. ※ Students enrolled in multiple majors/minors: Print out the Statement of Exchange Student Course Completion for each major/minor. (2) Submit the Statement for main major and other majors/minors to the administrative department. (By major) Statement of Exchange Student Course Completion + Academic Transcript from the hosting university + Course Outline (English/Korean) ※ Caution Only courses that have been reviewed for credit transfer in the main major in advance can be reviewed for transfer as a multiple major/minor credit. Please note that review for major courses is required even for classes unrelated to the major.
Step 4 [[College/Department]: The student’s department reviews academic performance, and sends results to the Academic Affairs Team. ※ Grades for each course completed overseas are ultimately reviewed and converted to P/F by the student’s department.
Step 5 [Academic Affairs Team]: Academic Affairs Team confirms the final grades. ※ If you discover an error that requires editing after submitting or printing documents, contact the Administrative Department at your college and ask them to activate the Edit function in the Credit Transfer Application Menu (OIA does not have the authority to edit any information input by the student).

passages.title: Subsidized Study Abroad Program
passages.text:
Eligibility: Applicants for Master's or Doctoral Programs Abroad Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree from Hanyang University and have a GPA of 3.5 or higher in both undergraduate and master's programs (master's degrees may be conferred from Hanyang University or other universities)
Applicants must apply within 3 years of obtaining their bachelor's or master's degree (excluding the military service period)
Applicants must be scheduled to enroll in an overseas master's/doctorate program sometime during the year of their application
Applicants must be under 35 years of age
Applicants must not otherwise be disqualified from studying abroad
Applicants must speak the language of the hosting country or be able to attend classes delivered in English (if classes are delivered in English regardless of the native language of the hosting country) ※ Foreign language proficiency scores must be from the past 2 years to qualify. ※ For English-speaking countries, the minimum scores are 91 for TOEFL IBT, or 6.5 for IELTS (same applies to applicants majoring in arts and physical education). ※ GRE, TOEIC, etc. scores are not recognized as language proficiency scores, but may be used for reference during the application process. ※ For other language-speaking countries, students must submit their language proficiency scores administered by the hosting country government (additional English scores may be required). ※ If the hosting country does not have a state-administered language proficiency test, students must submit their English proficiency scores.
If students receive multiple scholarships from other institutions, they must indicate whether they have received such scholarships.

Q. I am curious about the validity of the authenticated documents. Can I submit my
graduation certificate that was apostilled last year?
A. If there is an expiration date on an apostilled or consular confirmed document, the
validity of the document will be judged based on the date indicated on the authentication.
If there is no specific date indicated, the document will be accepted if it was submitted
within 2 years from the date of authentication.

should obtain an apostille if the relevant country is a member of the Apostille

can obtain a consular confirmation from the embassy/consulate of the relevant country.

Core Major Courses
Course Description
Cell Biology The course presents fundamental cellular structure and function principles, examining cellular metabolism, genetic information utilization, and intracellular signaling mechanisms through systematic study.
Biochemistry The course analyzes molecular structures and functions of macromolecules, including proteins, nucleic acids, lipids, and carbohydrates, examining catabolic and anabolic process mechanisms.
Genetics The course examines genetic discipline development through analysis of biological trait inheritance, providing a fundamental understanding of the inheritance concept while promoting scientific inquiry into biological phenomena.
Ecology The course presents fundamental ecological principles, including life origins, ancient Earth ecosystems, ecosystem structure and function, material cycles, terrestrial ecosystem characteristics, population and community dynamics, and evolutionary ecological processes.

If the hosting university has a conversion table, use it to convert your academic grades. In the absence of such a table, use the “Academic Grade Conversion Table by Country (Europe)” sent via e-mail from the Office of International Affairs. (2) Do not alter ECTS information arbitrarily (e.g. Multiplying 2/3) Students must enter the ECTS on their transcript into the system as is, and the credits will be corrected and entered into the system once their college administrator reviews the credits. ● Application Requirements
1. International students currently enrolled in a undergraduate program at the Seoul Campus, Hanyang University. (number of semesters completed: 2 or less)

degree: Undergraduate; The number of the semester of completion: 1 or 2; amount: KRW 300,000; Maximum number of TOPIK scholarships a student can receive: During the period of study up to once

Public administration is an applied social science field that promotes balanced national development
through efficient state operations. The 21st century has witnessed an increased emphasis on
governmental roles, highlighting the limitations of traditional governance and authority in executing
administrative functions. This evolution has precipitated fundamental changes in governmental
operations and management, establishing modern public administration as a systematic field of study.
The scope of public administration has expanded beyond the public sector to encompass partnerships
with private enterprises and non-profit organizations, reflecting the growing interconnectedness of
governmental activities.
The Department of Public Administration at Hanyang University cultivates expertise in future bureaucrats

practical application of academic research. The increasing public demand for administrative services
underscores the significance of highly competent bureaucrats and specialists

UNESCO i-WSSM & KIGAM
Summer Program on Groundwater Management and Natural Heritage
CALL FOR APPLICATIONS
International Centre for Water Security and Sustainable Management under the
auspices of UNESCO (i -WSSM) and the Korea Institute of Geoscience and Mineral
Resources (KIGAM) are hosting a capacity building program on groundwater from 11
July (Mon) – 15 July (Fri), 2022 at Daejeon and Jeju Island
Overview.
This program will be a great opportunity for students studying or interested in groundwater-
related issues, to learn from Korea’s leading researchers , and to gain practical knowledge
through lectures, study visits, and more.
Study Visit Locations Lectures
Hancheon and Hanbark Reservoir
Geomun Oreum
Cheonjeyon Waterfall
Hanon Maar Crater
Jeju Folk Village
Manjanggul (Cave)
(… and more!)
Water crisis and the role of groundwater
Groundwater use and policy in Korea
Groundwater contamination and remediation
Artificial recharge and Management of Coastal
Groundwater
Shallow Geothermal Energy System
Groundwater monitoring system on Jeju island

This capacity building program provides a comprehensive understanding of the geological
structure and the cycle of groundwater. Participants will learn the cultural and natur al value
of groundwater by visiting UNESCO’s World Heritage sites. (Jeju volcanic island and lava tubes)

study & quiz) and a 5-day offline(in-person)

passages.title: Short-term Outgoing Programs
passages.text:
Credit Transfer may vary depending on the course the student completed and their college (up to a maximum of 6 credits)
In case of European ECTS credits, 1ECTS = converted to Hanyang University credits at half score (multiply ECTS credits by 1/2)
Credits can be transferred as Self-financed Studies Abroad or Oversea's Language Training
Students cannot apply for redundant credits (e.g. apply for credits earned during their semester abroad and credits for a seasonal semester at Hanyang University)

passages.title: Subsidized Study Abroad Program
passages.section: What is a Subsidized Study Abroad Program?
passages.text: In 1981, Hanyang University became the first university in Korea to offer a subsidized study aboard program. The program provides scholarships to Hanyang University graduates who wish to study abroad for their master's or doctoral programs. It produces a large number of talented professionals each year and plays a key role in various aspects of society. The university is always on the lookout for interested graduates. Specific application windows and detailed selection requirements may be slightly modified each year, so please be sure to check the recruitment notice before applying (read online notices).

passages.section: Benefits and Obligations for Study Abroad Students
passages.text:

Leave of absence from school due to diseases other than COVID-19, employment

① Those who apply for the leave of absence must leave Korea within one month,
regardless of their visa validity periods.

or are not attending school to the Immigration Office each semester. Students who
stay in Korea without attending school are subject to fines from the Immigration
Office.
③ When you go back to your country after taking a leave of absence, you have to
return your alien registration card at the airport.
④ Students who stay and work in Korea illegally while on leave of absence might have
disadvantages when returning to the school.
⑤ Students who pay tuition and take leave of absence, can’t get tuition refunds.
Tuition will be carried over to next semester.

passages.title: Major Guidebook for International Students

Establishment Contact Number Website
1963 +82-2-2220-0850 http://comm.hanyang.ac.kr/main.php
The Department of Media Communication (formerly the Department of Journalism & Mass
Communication) examines diverse media and communication phenomena in contemporary society.
Media communication studies represent an interdisciplinary convergence point, integrating multiple
social sciences, including sociology, psychology, economics, political science, and information science.
Communication, encompassing expressing and transmitting thoughts and feelings through verbal,
written, and symbolic means, is a fundamental component of societal function. As noted by Peter
Drucker, “self-expression represents a critical human capability, with modern business and management
fundamentally dependent on communication competency.” Communication proficiency proves essential
across professional effectiveness, interpersonal relationships, persuasive discourse, and personal
development. Media serves as the primary vehicle for this communication process. The contemporary
media landscape demonstrates rapid evolution, advancing beyond traditional channels such as
correspondence, print journalism, radio, and television. Digital platforms, including internet applications,
interactive gaming, and social media networks accessed through computers and mobile devices, reflect
increasing technological sophistication in modern communication systems.
Contemporary society demonstrates extensive integration with media systems. Individual citizens,
commercial enterprises, and governmental institutions utilize diverse media platforms and artificial
intelligence tools, creating widespread societal impact. The Department of Media Communication
develops professionals with advanced communication capabilities and media literacy skills aligned with
contemporary societal requirements.

passages.title: Subsidized Study Abroad Program
passages.text:
Eligibility: Applicants for Master's or Doctoral Programs Abroad Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree from Hanyang University and have a GPA of 3.5 or higher in both undergraduate and master's programs (master's degrees may be conferred from Hanyang University or other universities)
Applicants must apply within 3 years of obtaining their bachelor's or master's degree (excluding the military service period)
Applicants must be scheduled to enroll in an overseas master's/doctorate program sometime during the year of their application
Applicants must be under 35 years of age
Applicants must not otherwise be disqualified from studying abroad
Applicants must speak the language of the hosting country or be able to attend classes delivered in English (if classes are delivered in English regardless of the native language of the hosting country) ※ Foreign language proficiency scores must be from the past 2 years to qualify. ※ For English-speaking countries, the minimum scores are 91 for TOEFL IBT, or 6.5 for IELTS (same applies to applicants majoring in arts and physical education). ※ GRE, TOEIC, etc. scores are not recognized as language proficiency scores, but may be used for reference during the application process. ※ For other language-speaking countries, students must submit their language proficiency scores administered by the hosting country government (additional English scores may be required). ※ If the hosting country does not have a state-administered language proficiency test, students must submit their English proficiency scores.
If students receive multiple scholarships from other institutions, they must indicate whether they have received such scholarships.

ArchitectureSchool of Architecture
Fostering creative architectural leaders who will shape
the future of architecture
Human life is fundamentally centered around “spaces.” The School of Architecture cultivates architects
qualified to design spaces that meet diverse human needs. As reflected in the saying, “people make
buildings, buildings make people,” architects design not only buildings but also shape the lives within them.
All buildings, whether designed for private or public purposes, constitute the fundamental elements of
a city. Enduring structures preserve society's collective memories and meaning while reflecting its art,
technology, history, and culture. Certain buildings become emblematic of their historical periods. The
School of Architecture at Hanyang University aims to cultivate “creative architectural leaders” who will
advance the field of architecture.

passages.text:
Since the program allows students to study at non-sister overseas universities, students can study at the university of their choice.

question: My exchange semester is ending soon. What do I have to do to get the credits recognised back home at Hanyang?

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text:
Before departure, students must decide on the courses they plan to take at the hosting university and check with their home university's administrative team whether the courses can be transferred for credit.
As for minors and multiple majors, students must check in advance whether credits can be transferred by the relevant college at Hanyang University.

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text: Step 1 [Office of International Affairs]: School registration transfer and credit transfer procedures Returning students must complete their Return Report on the HY-in system (Student HY-in > Application > Credit Exchange Management > Exchange & Study Abroad > Exchange Study Abroad Application History menu)

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text: Step 2 [[Student]]: Upload the Return Report to HY-in Before the end of the Exchange/study abroad Program, students must read the Credit Transfer Procedure sent to their private e-mail account and enter all relevant coursework (information of the semester completed, courses taken (English), credits earned for each subject, grade) completed at the hosting university directly on the HY-in system (directory: Student HY-in - Application - Academic Grades - Hosting University Credit Transfer Application menu) (1) What if the hosting university does note grade students on an alphabetical grading system (e.g. ABCDF)? If the hosting university has a conversion table, use it to convert your academic grades. In the absence of such a table, use the “Academic Grade Conversion Table by Country (Europe)” sent via e-mail from the Office of International Affairs. (2) Do not alter ECTS information arbitrarily (e.g. Multiplying 2/3) Students must enter the ECTS on their transcript into the system as is, and the credits will be corrected and entered into the system once their college administrator reviews the credits. (3) What if a student receives an “F” grade or drops out of a course? Enter information as it appears on the academic transcript. ※ Caution Course names must be entered in English, and all credits or grades must be entered exactly as they appear on the transcript. If you discover an error that requires editing after submitting or printing documents, contact the administrative department at your college and

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text: Caution Course names must be entered in English, and all credits or grades must be entered exactly as they appear on the transcript. If you discover an error that requires editing after submitting or printing documents, contact the administrative department at your college and ask them to activate the Edit function in the Credit Transfer Application Menu. Once you click to save drafts, the system will register any input information or documents. Exercise caution when submitting all documents.

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text:
Step 3 [[Student]]: Submit materials for credit transfer review (1) Print out the Statement of Exchange Student Course Completion Upon entering academic grades in the HY-in system, click the <Print> button at the top of the screen to print. ※ Students enrolled in multiple majors/minors: Print out the Statement of Exchange Student Course Completion for each major/minor. (2) Submit the Statement for main major and other majors/minors to the administrative department. (By major) Statement of Exchange Student Course Completion + Academic Transcript from the hosting university + Course Outline (English/Korean) ※ Caution Only courses that have been reviewed for credit transfer in the main major in advance can be reviewed for transfer as a multiple major/minor credit. Please note that review for major courses is required even for classes unrelated to the major.
Step 4 [[College/Department]: The student’s department reviews academic performance, and sends results to the Academic Affairs Team. ※ Grades for each course completed overseas are ultimately reviewed and converted to P/F by the student’s department.
Step 5 [Academic Affairs Team]: Academic Affairs Team confirms the final grades. ※ If you discover an error that requires editing after submitting or printing documents, contact the Administrative Department at your college and ask them to activate the Edit function in the Credit Transfer Application Menu (OIA does not have the authority to edit any information input by the student).

passages.section: What is a Subsidized Study Abroad Program?
passages.text: In 1981, Hanyang University became the first university in Korea to offer a subsidized study aboard program. The program provides scholarships to Hanyang University graduates who wish to study abroad for their master's or doctoral programs. It produces a large number of talented professionals each year and plays a key role in various aspects of society. The university is always on the lookout for interested graduates. passages.title: Major Guidebook for International Students
passages.text:

social meaning across cultural contexts and contributing to identity formation at
both individual and collective levels. Students explore sport's influence on social
development, its intersection with historical events, and its broader cultural and
societal implications.
e-Sports Theory
The course comprehensively analyzes the e-sports industry's historical development,
current ecosystem, and future trajectories. It examines gameplay mechanics, media
platforms, and competition structures. Students develop an understanding of e-sports
fan engagement, distinctions from traditional sports, and digital entertainment
culture's impact on the industry's evolution and prospects.
Sports Economics
The course analyzes the sports industry through an economic lens. It examines
market dynamics, including supply-demand relationships, market structures, and
labor markets. Students develop a comprehensive understanding of economic
principles within the sports market context, analyzing interactions between
individuals, businesses, public entities, and governmental institutions.
Sociology of Sport
The course examines sport as a sociocultural phenomenon, analyzing its relationships
with various social systems and structures. It explores sport's connections to political,
economic, and educational frameworks and its intersection with social relations,
including class, gender, and race. Students develop an understanding of sport's
globalization process within economic, political, and cultural contexts, establishing
foundational knowledge in sports industry studies.

question: After a self-financed study abroad program, who reviews my credit transfer and where do I hand in the documents?

passages.title: Self-financed Study Abroad Program
passages.text:
Regular semesters: A maximum of 20 credits may be transferred per semester, with a maximum of 40 credits per year
Seasonal semesters: A maximum of 6 credits may be transferred per application
Credits may be transferred as part of a student’s main major, second major, and minor , in liberal arts, or general elective credits (only for the pre-approved majors).
All authority for credit transfer lies with the college at which the student is enrolled in, and the process is also carried out by said college.
Only programs that can issue transcripts with credits for each subject can apply for credit transfer (Credits will NOT be transferred if the program issues certificates of completion only).

passages.title: Self-financed Study Abroad Program
passages.text:

Course Description
Quantum Mechanics
1 & 2
The course presents fundamental concepts and methodological approaches for analyzing
microscopic systems, including atomic and molecular structures and behaviors.
Electromagnetism 1 & 2 The course examines theoretical frameworks describing electrical and magnetic phenomena, systematically studying electromagnetic wave properties.
Thermal and Statistical
Physics 1 & 2
The course analyzes thermodynamic laws and statistical distribution applications in many-
body system analysis, examining multiple particle system properties.
Classical Mechanics
1 & 2
The course applies Newtonian motion principles and conservation laws to particle system
dynamics, including vibration analysis, rigid body rotation, and advanced mechanical
systems.

passages.title: Subsidized Study Abroad Program
passages.section: What is a Subsidized Study Abroad Program?
passages.text: In 1981, Hanyang University became the first university in Korea to offer a subsidized study aboard program. The program provides scholarships to Hanyang University graduates who wish to study abroad for their master's or doctoral programs. It produces a large number of talented professionals each year and plays a key role in various aspects of society. The university is always on the lookout for interested graduates. Specific application windows and detailed selection requirements may be slightly modified each year, so please be sure to check the recruitment notice before applying (read online notices).

passages.title: Subsidized Study Abroad Program
passages.section: Benefits and Obligations for Study Abroad Students
passages.text:

Approx. USD 5,400 paid each semester for up to 2 years (4 semesters) depending on the scholarship period

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text:
Before departure, students must decide on the courses they plan to take at the hosting university and check with their home university's administrative team whether the courses can be transferred for credit.
As for minors and multiple majors, students must check in advance whether credits can be transferred by the relevant college at Hanyang University.

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text: Step 1 [Office of International Affairs]: School registration transfer and credit transfer procedures Returning students must complete their Return Report on the HY-in system (Student HY-in > Application > Credit Exchange Management > Exchange & Study Abroad > Exchange Study Abroad Application History menu)

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text: Step 2 [[Student]]: Upload the Return Report to HY-in Before the end of the Exchange/study abroad Program, students must read the Credit Transfer Procedure sent to their private e-mail account and enter all relevant coursework (information of the semester completed, courses taken (English), credits earned for each subject, grade) completed at the hosting university directly on the HY-in system (directory: Student HY-in - Application - Academic Grades - Hosting University Credit Transfer Application menu) (1) What if the hosting university does note grade students on an alphabetical grading system (e.g. ABCDF)? If the hosting university has a conversion table, use it to convert your academic grades. In the absence of such a table, use the “Academic Grade Conversion Table by Country (Europe)” sent via e-mail from the Office of International Affairs. (2) Do not alter ECTS information arbitrarily (e.g. Multiplying 2/3) Students must enter the ECTS on their transcript into the system as is, and the credits will be corrected and entered into the system once their college administrator reviews the credits. (3) What if a student receives an “F” grade or drops out of a course? Enter information as it appears on the academic transcript. ※ Caution Course names must be entered in English, and all credits or grades must be entered exactly as they appear on the transcript. If you discover an error that requires editing after submitting or printing documents, contact the administrative department at your college and

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text: Caution Course names must be entered in English, and all credits or grades must be entered exactly as they appear on the transcript. If you discover an error that requires editing after submitting or printing documents, contact the administrative department at your college and ask them to activate the Edit function in the Credit Transfer Application Menu. Once you click to save drafts, the system will register any input information or documents. Exercise caution when submitting all documents.

passages.title: Outgoing Programs
passages.text:
Step 3 [[Student]]: Submit materials for credit transfer review (1) Print out the Statement of Exchange Student Course Completion Upon entering academic grades in the HY-in system, click the <Print> button at the top of the screen to print. ※ Students enrolled in multiple majors/minors: Print out the Statement of Exchange Student Course Completion for each major/minor. (2) Submit the Statement for main major and other majors/minors to the administrative department. (By major) Statement of Exchange Student Course Completion + Academic Transcript from the hosting university + Course Outline (English/Korean) ※ Caution Only courses that have been reviewed for credit transfer in the main major in advance can be reviewed for transfer as a multiple major/minor credit. Please note that review for major courses is required even for classes unrelated to the major.
Step 4 [[College/Department]: The student’s department reviews academic performance, and sends results to the Academic Affairs Team. ※ Grades for each course completed overseas are ultimately reviewed and converted to P/F by the student’s department.
Step 5 [Academic Affairs Team]: Academic Affairs Team confirms the final grades. ※ If you discover an error that requires editing after submitting or printing documents, contact the Administrative Department at your college and ask them to activate the Edit function in the Credit Transfer Application Menu (OIA does not have the authority to edit any information input by the student).

passages.title: Employment | Now Recruiting: Gyeonggi Global Job Supporters (SNS Foreign Employment…
passages.section: Employment | Now Recruiting: Gyeonggi Global Job Supporters (SNS Foreign Employment…
passages.text:
The Foreign Employment Support Center of the Gyeonggi Job Foundation is recruiting members for the [ Gyeonggi Global Job Supporters (SNS Foreign Employment Ambassadors) ].
Participants will be able to post and promote information related to employment opportunities for foreigners through their own SNS (social media) accounts. The program is open to foreign residents in Korea.
- Recruitment Period: March 4, 2026 – March 25, 2026
- Eligibility: Foreign residents legally staying in Korea with a valid visa, especially those who manage influential communities or SNS accounts.
- Activities: Posting SNS content related to foreign employment at least once a week, Participating in related events
- Benefits: Activity allowance (e.g., attendance stipend), SNS-related training, Rewards for outstanding participants, Certificate of appointment
- Application Method: Apply online via Jobaba Apply( https://apply.jobaba.net/bsns/bsnsDetailView.do?bsnsSeq=5320) (or scan the QR code on the poster)
- Details: Please refer to the poster for more information.

ArchitectureSchool of Architecture
Fostering creative architectural leaders who will shape
the future of architecture
Human life is fundamentally centered around “spaces.” The School of Architecture cultivates architects
qualified to design spaces that meet diverse human needs. As reflected in the saying, “people make
buildings, buildings make people,” architects design not only buildings but also shape the lives within them.
All buildings, whether designed for private or public purposes, constitute the fundamental elements of

technology, history, and culture. Certain buildings become emblematic of their historical periods. The

advance the field of architecture.

question: I went to the hospital last week. How do I claim the costs from the university's group insurance?

passages.title: International Student Insurance
passages.text:
Insurance premiums are charged to each student’s tuition bill every semester. Students may register and enroll once they pay their full tuition and insurance premium amount.
Failure to pay the insurance premium within the tuition payment period will render the student unable to enroll and thus be expelled from the university
No insurance benefits when using medical institutions for treatment or care

passages.title: International Student Insurance
passages.text:
In the case of medical expenses stemming from hospitalization and surgery, the insurance company pays the medical expenses directly to the hospital.
However, upon discharge, the student must pay 30% of the medical expenses as a deposit to the hospital.

It is designed for international students to enable themselves to work on research projects under the supervision of Hanyang faculty members in the STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) fields. Students will be able to participate in the different phases of research activities and develop a the network with renowned faculties and postgraduate students during the program.

Nutrition
The course examines physiological and biochemical nutrient functions essential for human life maintenance and analyzes optimal nutrient
requirements for health maintenance. Students develop an understanding of the fundamental properties, functions, metabolism, and sources

Food Analytics The course presents comprehensive food component analysis methodologies, examining sampling techniques and analytical methods for moisture, fats, proteins, carbohydrates, fiber, metals, vitamins, and specialized ingredients.
Clinical Nutrition The course analyzes nutrition-related disease diagnosis, treatment, and prevention strategies based on nutrient-body interactions, examining deficiency conditions, excess consumption, and metabolic imbalances.
Food Processing and
Storage
The course examines physical, chemical, and biological transformations during food processing and storage, analyzing manufacturing
process characteristics and storage methodology principles across food categories. Based on the theory and knowledge of food processing
and storage, students understand each food item's chemical and physical characteristics and learn related preventive and operational
methods.
Food Hygiene The course presents contemporary food hygiene trends, including food poisoning analysis, spoilage prevention, hygiene measures, contamination sources, food additives, and carcinogen relationships, developing preventive expertise for food safety.

question: How many credits can I get transferred after doing a self-financed study abroad program?

passages.title: Self-financed Study Abroad Program
passages.text:
Regular semesters: A maximum of 20 credits may be transferred per semester, with a maximum of 40 credits per year
Seasonal semesters: A maximum of 6 credits may be transferred per application
Credits may be transferred as part of a student’s main major, second major, and minor , in liberal arts, or general elective credits (only for the pre-approved majors).
All authority for credit transfer lies with the college at which the student is enrolled in, and the process is also carried out by said college.
Only programs that can issue transcripts with credits for each subject can apply for credit transfer (Credits will NOT be transferred if the program issues certificates of completion only).

Biomedical EngineeringBiomedical Engineering (Electrical Engineering) (Electrical Engineering)
Cultivating electrical energy expertise to address future
energy challenges
Electrical energy represents the foundational energy source across engineering disciplines, enabling
functionality from residential applications to robotic systems and precision control mechanisms. The
field demonstrates increasing significance amid the contemporary focus on renewable and alternative
energy development. Electrical engineering encompasses the comprehensive study of electrical
systems from generation and transmission through consumption processes. The Electrical Engineering
program at Hanyang University's School of Electrical and Biomedical Engineering encompasses three
primary concentrations: future electric energy systems, plasma and electrical materials, and artificial
intelligence integration with control and signal processing. The future electrical energy concentration
examines next-generation electrical energy generation, control systems, transmission methods, and
conversion processes. The concentration of plasma and electrical materials addresses plasma electricity
applications, process equipment development, electrical semiconductor material processes, and wireless
power transmission technologies. The artificial intelligence, control, and signal processing concentration
advances methodologies for optimizing electrical generation, conversion, and utilization efficiency.
The program provides comprehensive education across electrical engineering domains, including
generation systems, conversion processes, transmission technologies, consumption patterns, and control
mechanisms, addressing future energy challenges through integrated electrical solutions.

Scholarship Application
- Application Period: 2022.9.1 (Thu) 10:00 a.m. ~ 9.16 (Fri) by 17:00 p.m.

1. Introduction
HIEA aims to help international students have successful life of studying abroad in HYU who
have achieved notable academic progress and been a good example for other students.
2. Who is eligible for HIEA?
① Students who are currently attending campus and studying at the HYU for more than
1 semester. (Except students who took a leave of absence, completed studies but haven’t
graduate, extended school or didn’t pay the tuition fee)
② Students who was entered by those admission processes like 1) International students
with foreign citizenship whose parents both have foreign citizenship(Undergrad & Grad) or 2)
International students including Koreans residing overseas who have completed the entire
elementary, middle, high school and undergraduate education outside Korea(Grad). (Including
English track)
③ Students who is taking another scholarship in the university such as academic scholarships
from your departments or natural sciences engineering scholarships.
※ But when you receive bigger amounts of HIEA scholarship than others, we provide the
difference only.
Case #1 When you are selected for 30%/50% of HIEA while receiving 50% of natural
sciences engineering scholarship.

· Guidance on writing Korean-style resumes and cover letters, and
interview preparation
